title: Paloma and the Colony
author: Mirabel Halloran
blurb: Theo Galloway, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
